generationMethod: authored by hand from directory listings and file counts observed in the working tree on 2026-11-03; no generator script produces this file
scope: Provenance, rights state and publication state of every asset family that the MC-17 design system consumes, references or deliberately does not consume, plus the state of public/.
knownLimitations: File counts are directory counts observed at authoring time; a later commit changes them and this dataset must be re-derived, not trusted.

No licence review, originality opinion, trademark clearance or professional resemblance check exists for any family listed here. Every licenceCleared and originalityClaim value is false because no such clearance was performed, not because it was performed and denied.
The MC-04 candidate library is internal design evidence under a proposed brand; the absence of a public copy in public/ is verified by the validator check MC17-11, not by this file alone.
Per-file SHA-256 registration belongs to the asset manifest (MC-04 QA-23, still incomplete); this dataset records families and counts, not hashes.

governance.note: No asset in this dataset may be published, and no MAREA logo, lockup, icon master or render may be copied into public/ in MC-17.

publicState.verifiedBy: MC17-11 — PASS, detail '15 public files unchanged, zero MAREA assets'

prohibitedActions: Copying any MC-04 logo, lockup, mark, icon master, diagram, packaging dieline, social card, print record or render into public/.
Presenting a MAREA mark, family lockup or icon as a registered trademark, a certification mark or a clearance.
Labelling MC-04 candidate artwork as adopted identity or as professionally cleared.
Importing a third-party icon library, tracing a competitor icon set or bundling downloaded artwork.
